officialDocsValidated.summary: os.tmpdir() resolves from TMPDIR (POSIX) with no documented process-lifetime caching; this story's design depends on it re-reading TMPDIR per call so a test can redirect it via process.env.TMPDIR before invoking writeShipPrTempFile. Behavior confirmed empirically by this story's own test suite (3/3 pass with TMPDIR redirected at call time), consistent with the CAM-508 handoff's prior empirical measurement on bun 1.3.13 that os.tmpdir() re-reads TMPDIR on every call.
